commitResults.messageTitle: Anchor core storage paths to the packaged JAR
commitResults.messageBody:
Resolve preferences, client data and the instance lock from the real JAR
folder so launching from another directory does not select another data
set or bypass the original lock. Keep exploded-class working-directory
behavior and leave diagnostic logging to the dependent S1 change.

Verify packaged startup, restarts, shared locks and persistence failures
in separate JVMs, plus URI encoding and resolver fallback cases.

Refs #259

Distinguish JAR-relative storage from IDE and Gradle development runs
so setup instructions select the intended data folder. Explain symbolic
links, isolated manual checks and the risk of retaining data in build/.
Resolve core storage paths relative to the packaged JAR

commitResults.messageTitle: Make Unicode JAR launch tests portable
commitResults.messageBody:
Keep the Unicode JAR code source while avoiding raw Unicode arguments
that the Windows launcher cannot open. Launch this fixture relatively
from a child folder and transport its expected location as an ASCII URI.

Retain absolute-path launches in the other scenarios and preserve all
storage, lock and CodeSource assertions. Change test code only.
Keep Unicode JAR-home tests portable on Windows
